Test Case: On new-study choose Testament (OT/NT) via radio buttons
Expected Result: Book list updates to books of the chosen testament

Test Case: Change the book selection
Expected Result: Chapters reset to 1, verses reset to full range of chapter 1

Test Case: Change the testament after selecting a book
Expected Result: Book resets to first book of new testament, chapters and verses reset

Test Case: Set From Chapter greater than current To Chapter
Expected Result: To Chapter adjusts (or is constrained) so range stays valid

Test Case: Select from/to verses within a single chapter
Expected Result: Verse dropdowns show only valid verse numbers for that chapter

Test Case: Select a passage spanning multiple chapters
Expected Result: From/To verse options match the respective chapters' verse counts

Test Case: Add a second passage with the add button
Expected Result: A new passage row appears with sensible defaults

Test Case: Remove a passage from a multi-passage list
Expected Result: Correct passage is removed; remaining passages unchanged

Test Case: Attempt to remove the only remaining passage
Expected Result: Removal is prevented or handled gracefully as designed

Test Case: Drag a passage row to reorder within the list
Expected Result: Ghost/drop indicator shows; new order is retained on save

Test Case: Start a passage drag and release without moving past threshold
Expected Result: No reorder occurs; row returns to normal state

Test Case: Select each available translation when creating a study
Expected Result: Study is created with the chosen translation and text matches it

Test Case: Select a translation with passage/verse limits and exceed them
Expected Result: Limit is enforced with a clear message

Test Case: Proceed to the review step after selecting passages
Expected Result: Review page shows the correct passage text for each selection

Test Case: Go back from review to modify passages
Expected Result: Previous selections are preserved and editable

Test Case: Complete study creation from review
Expected Result: Study is created and opens with passages rendered in Analyze view

Test Case: Open an existing study and edit its passages (analyze-edit)
Expected Result: Existing passages are shown; adding a passage preserves existing structure work

Test Case: Remove a passage from an existing study
Expected Result: Warning about losing related work is shown; remaining passages keep their structure

Test Case: Extend the verse range of an existing passage
Expected Result: New verses appear; existing segment/section structure is reconciled without corruption

Test Case: Shrink the verse range of an existing passage
Expected Result: Removed verses disappear; remaining structure remains valid

Test Case: Begin editing a study's passages then navigate away without saving
Expected Result: Unsaved-changes protection triggers (prompt or safe discard) as designed

Test Case: Open a study while the Bible API is slow or unavailable
Expected Result: Cached passage text loads or a clear error state is shown

Test Case: Create a study with a single-verse passage (e.g. Jude 1:1)
Expected Result: Passage renders correctly with one verse

Test Case: Create a study with an entire book (e.g. Philemon)
Expected Result: All chapters/verses load and render correctly
